test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains as error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

The sky appeared to be __greyest__ after the storm.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. grey .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**greyest**" is incorrectly used in the sentence. Since we are describing the appearance of the sky at a specific moment after the storm, the simple adjective "**grey**" should be used.
 
• Using "**grey**" makes the sentence grammatically correct and meaningful.
 
• The other options (more grey, greyer, most grey) do not fit the context of the sentence as effectively.

Correct sentence: *The sky appeared to be **grey** after the storm*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Forms and Usage of "Grey":**

 
 
• **Grey:** Adjective - having a color intermediate between black and white.
 
• **Comparative and Superlative Forms:**
 
 
• **Greyer:** Comparative form - used to compare two things (The sky is greyer today compared to yesterday).
 
• **Greyest:** Superlative form - used to compare more than two things (This is the greyest day of the year).
